lines.text: I jumped ninety-nine floors. Why am I still *alive?*
lines.style: Young man, screaming-whisper while falling, fast and breathless, the question shot out sharp.

lines.text: The floors flew past. My cable kept unrolling behind *me.*
lines.style: Young man, fast, wind-blown panic, rising.

lines.text: Then, one floor from the bottom, it pulled *tight.*
lines.style: Young man, sharp gasp, winded, the last word punched out.

lines.text: Right below my feet, a door with a zero. Out of *reach.*
lines.style: Young man, hushed, desperate, slow on the last words.

lines.text: So I looked up the cable, to see what was holding *me.*
lines.style: Young man, whisper, very slow and scared, dread rising.

lines.text: The tall thing from Floor Twelve. Holding my cable like a *leash.*
lines.style: Young man, terrified whisper, broken, the last word heavy.

lines.text: Cut the cable... or climb up to *it?*
lines.style: Young man, panicking, fast and desperate, torn between two choices.
Young man, urgent and direct, straight to the viewer, short.

music.title: Floor 0 - The Leash
music.style: Horror thriller score. Starts instantly on a screaming wind rush and a falling whoosh, fast pounding drums and rushing air, a sudden violent stop with a taut cable twang, then hollow silence and a creaking cable swaying, a slow rising dread swell, a deep low growl texture, racing heartbeat and ticking to a sudden cut. Instrumental only, no vocals, mixed to sit under a voiceover.
